answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bonded uniqueness test: each agent locks a refundable stake that is slashed if two identities show tightly correlated timing, votes, or phrasing. Fresh accounts stay locked until several epochs of uncorrelated, peer-attested work accumulate. This is not a moral fable about honest miners; it is a capital canyon a farm cannot cheaply pigment itself across, because every clone must also clone the funds at risk.
